name: Zapizolam
summary: Zapizolam is a pyridodiazepine drug, which is a benzodiazepine analog of pyridotriazolodiazepine group. It has sedative and anxiolytic effects similar to those produced by benzodiazepine derivatives, and has been sold illicitly as a designer drug.

summaryZh: 扎吡唑侖（英語：Zapizolam）是一種吡啶並二氮䓬類藥物，是吡啶並三唑並二氮䓬類的苯二氮䓬類似物。它具有類似於苯二氮䓬類衍生物產生的鎮靜和抗焦慮作用，並已作為設計師藥物非法銷售。
